question: What measured amount of water is to be used after proper assessment?
premises: Proper assessment must precede the action
The method must be applied correctly
One-and-half measure of water or water alone is specified
inference: After proper assessment, one-and-half measure of water or only water should be used.
plain_english: But having known properly and correctly, one should use one-and-a-half measures of water, or only water.
